findings.evidence: The endings loop returns on its first iteration, so the ValueError for a missing rule (lines 135-136) is raised only for the highest-rank/lowest-id ending; a lower-ranked ENDS observation without a rule is silently ignored. test_structural_end_requires_a_rule covers only the single-ending case.
findings.title: Only the selected structural ending is rule-validated
